description: This file defines the class AzureAISearchDefaultOptionsConfigurations, which configures default options for Azure AI Search within the OrchardCore framework. It manages configuration sources, including file-based and UI-based settings, and handles authentication setup.

classes.name: AzureAISearchDefaultOptionsConfigurations
classes.description: A class that implements configuration logic for Azure AI Search options, supporting both file-based and UI-based configurations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Main method to configure AzureAISearchDefaultOptions based on file and UI settings.

methods.name: InitializeFromFileSettings
methods.description: Sets options based on file configuration.

methods.name: InitializeFromUISettings
methods.description: Sets options based on UI configuration.

methods.name: HasConnectionInfo
methods.description: Checks if the options contain valid connection information.
